data.title: Discord Game Stats Widget Updates
data.brief: Arknights: Endfield Game Stats Widget updated. New operator "Typhoeus" theme is now live!How to Sele
data.data:
Arknights: Endfield Game Stats Widget updated. New operator "Typhoeus" theme is now live!


How to Select the "Typhoeus" Theme:

- First, link your Discord Account, then visit the Linking page, click [Select a theme to display], select Typhoeus's avatar and click [Confirm].

- After linking, head to Discord > Avatar > Edit Profile > Add Widgets, then select the Arknights: Endfield Game Stats Widget to display the "Typhoeus" Theme.

- You can also display more game info on Discord, including your nickname, server, account level, and playtime.

- Linking for the first time will also grant you [Oroberyl×100] and an exclusive role in our official Discord server.


>>>Link Now:

https://endfield.gryphline.com/special/discord-binding


For more details on Discord account linking and the Game Stats Widget, please head to the official Discord server:

https://discord.gg/Ssh74ME2Y4
